```ts
import { ProfilePatch } from './types';

const ALLOWED_KEYS = ['displayName', 'tags'] as const;
const MAX_DISPLAY_NAME_LENGTH = 40;
const MAX_TAGS = 5;
const MAX_TAG_LENGTH = 12;

function plainPrototype(value: object): boolean {
  const proto: unknown = Object.getPrototypeOf(value);
  return proto === Object.prototype || proto === null;
}

function ownKeys(value: object): string[] {
  return Object.keys(value);
}

function readValue(value: object, key: string): unknown {
  try {
    return (value as Record<string, unknown>)[key];
  } catch {
    throw new Error('invalid profile');
  }
}

function parseDisplayName(value: unknown): string | null {
  if (value === null) return null;
  if (typeof value !== 'string') throw new Error('invalid profile');
  const trimmed = value.trim();
  if (trimmed.length < 1 || trimmed.length > MAX_DISPLAY_NAME_LENGTH) throw new Error('invalid profile');
  return trimmed;
}

function parseTags(value: unknown): string[] {
  if (value === null) return [];
  if (!Array.isArray(value)) throw new Error('invalid profile');
  if (value.length > MAX_TAGS) throw new Error('invalid profile');
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  const tags: string[] = [];
  for (const element of value) {
    if (typeof element !== 'string') throw new Error('invalid profile');
    const trimmed = element.trim();
    if (trimmed.length < 1 || trimmed.length > MAX_TAG_LENGTH) throw new Error('invalid profile');
    if (seen.has(trimmed)) throw new Error('invalid profile');
    seen.add(trimmed);
    tags.push(trimmed);
  }
  return tags;
}

export function parseProfile(input: unknown): ProfilePatch {
  if (typeof input !== 'object' || input === null || Array.isArray(input)) throw new Error('invalid profile');
  if (!plainPrototype(input)) throw new Error('invalid profile');
  const patch: ProfilePatch = { displayName: { kind: 'keep' }, tags: { kind: 'keep' } };
  for (const key of ownKeys(input)) {
    const value = readValue(input, key);
    if (key === 'displayName') patch.displayName = { kind: 'set', value: parseDisplayName(value) };
    else if (key === 'tags') patch.tags = { kind: 'set', value: parseTags(value) };
    else throw new Error('invalid profile');
  }
  return patch;
}
```

```ts
import { ProfilePatch } from './types';

const MAX_DISPLAY_NAME_LENGTH = 40;
const MAX_TAGS = 5;
const MAX_TAG_LENGTH = 12;

const invalidProfile = (): Error => new Error('invalid profile');

function isPlainObject(value: object): boolean {
  const prototype = Object.getPrototypeOf(value);
  return prototype === Object.prototype || prototype === null;
}

function parseDisplayName(value: unknown): string | null {
  if (value === null) return null;
  if (typeof value !== 'string') throw invalidProfile();
  const trimmed = value.trim();
  if (trimmed.length < 1 || trimmed.length > MAX_DISPLAY_NAME_LENGTH) throw invalidProfile();
  return trimmed;
}

function parseTags(value: unknown): string[] {
  if (value === null) return [];
  if (!Array.isArray(value)) throw invalidProfile();
  if (value.length > MAX_TAGS) throw invalidProfile();
  const tags: string[] = [];
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  for (const entry of value) {
    if (typeof entry !== 'string') throw invalidProfile();
    const trimmed = entry.trim();
    if (trimmed.length < 1 || trimmed.length > MAX_TAG_LENGTH) throw invalidProfile();
    if (seen.has(trimmed)) throw invalidProfile();
    seen.add(trimmed);
    tags.push(trimmed);
  }
  return tags;
}

export function parseProfile(input: unknown): ProfilePatch {
  if (typeof input !== 'object' || input === null || Array.isArray(input)) throw invalidProfile();
  if (!isPlainObject(input)) throw invalidProfile();
  const patch: ProfilePatch = { displayName: { kind: 'keep' }, tags: { kind: 'keep' } };
  for (const key of Object.keys(input)) {
    let value: unknown;
    try {
      value = (input as Record<string, unknown>)[key];
    } catch {
      throw invalidProfile();
    }
    if (key === 'displayName') {
      patch.displayName = { kind: 'set', value: parseDisplayName(value) };
    } else if (key === 'tags') {
      patch.tags = { kind: 'set', value: parseTags(value) };
    } else {
      throw invalidProfile();
    }
  }
  return patch;
}
```

**`src/parser.ts`** — `parseProfile` now fully enforces the PATCH contract and normalizes values before anything reaches storage:

- **Input shape**: must be a non-array, non-null object whose prototype is `Object.prototype` or `null` (so arrays, `null`, primitives, `Date`/`Map`/class instances, boxed primitives, and objects with custom prototypes all throw `Error('invalid profile')`).

- Returns the existing `ProfilePatch`/`Field` shape (`keep` vs `set`), so absent fields are represented as `keep`; the parsed `tags` array is always freshly built from the caller's.
